description: transaction.ex:392 case only matches {:ok,_}/{:found,_}; read_write_conflicts/1's callback (577-599) returns bare {:error, reason} -> CaseClauseError on CRC-valid-but-corrupt conflict payloads (e.g. count=5, no range data). Violates @spec. Resolver caller (transaction_conflicts.ex:70) has an {:error,_} graceful-degrade branch that's currently unreachable — resolver process crashes instead on wire input from commit proxy. Fix: add {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason} to the case (or wrap callback errors); add regression asserting {:error, :truncated_conflict_data} from read_write_conflicts/1. Audit-verified in PR for bedrock-aec.
title: iterate_sections_data doesn't propagate callback errors; read_write_conflicts crashes on corrupt payloads
